title: Virtual Compute: invoice grouping basis
content:
## Meaning — invoice grouping basis

Virtual Compute invoice grouping basis: Invoice grouping keys within the customer portfolio; string list.

## Tier values — invoice grouping basis

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — invoice grouping basis: legal billing entity; currency; period.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — invoice grouping basis: legal billing entity; currency; period.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — invoice grouping basis: legal billing entity; currency; period.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — invoice grouping basis: legal billing entity; currency; period.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — invoice grouping basis: legal billing entity; currency; period.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — invoice grouping basis: legal billing entity; currency; period.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for invoice grouping basis?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has invoice grouping basis of legal billing entity; currency; period.

## Meaning — default remittance allocation order

Virtual Compute default remittance allocation order: Default allocation of an unspecified remittance; deterministic string.

## Tier values — default remittance allocation order

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — default remittance allocation order: invoice issue time, then original source reference.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — default remittance allocation order: invoice issue time, then original source reference.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — default remittance allocation order: invoice issue time, then original source reference.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — default remittance allocation order: invoice issue time, then original source reference.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — default remittance allocation order: invoice issue time, then original source reference.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — default remittance allocation order: invoice issue time, then original source reference.

## Basis Q&A

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has default remittance allocation order of invoice issue time, then original source reference.
